submission_owner: operations worker only; Codex must not submit or monitor
runner_note: Use PR #494 gcp1 standard runner (or merged primary); source_worktree is the frozen snapshot input.
stop_rule: Any confirmed shared physical/control defect -> operations writes SUPERVISOR_STOP.json and stops owned same-candidate running/pending runs; preserve raw, fix as one bundle and restart; never fill the gate just for N. Unknown/unconfirmed RGB blocks release and gate.

admission.count_scope: all running/reserved jobs on gcp1, including other queues
admission.reservation: operations must count and reserve slots under its shared admission lock before each launch; no independent check-then-launch
